Input 1 is the personally inspected healthy F1 markup: Tomori plus WHOLE pencil and open notebook deliberately painted pure white. Input 2 is the exact root-approved clean original mother ONLY to distinguish actual foreground/perimeter/gaps from naturally light room. Do not redraw body or relocate anything. Same full canvas and all source coordinates, no crop/resize/zoom/recenter/erosion/dilation/shift.

Output PURE BLACK background and the COMPLETE already-whitened original foreground SOLID FEATURELESS WHITE: every short hair strand/tip, full head/face/eyes/ears/neck, all blazer/shirt/collar/sleeves/cuffs/skirt/lowest hem, both complete hands/fingers/wrists, bare thighs/knees, both calf socks, BOTH COMPLETE loafers including toe sidewalls/sole rims/heel blocks/bottommost edges, the WHOLE THIN PENCIL from upper end to point, and entire OPEN NOTEBOOK including all dark cover/spine/lower binding resting against lap. No black inner cover seam, clothing fold, eye/mouth, pencil centerline, hand outline or shoe seam. Faint internal tracing is not a hole; fill selected interiors fully white.

Preserve only real outside/background gaps BETWEEN separated hair strands, arm and torso, or legs as BLACK. The narrow original room slit between the viewer-left bent arm and torso around x1000..1020,y460..500 is a genuine outside gap: follow the exact original/F1 gap, no new holes in the sleeve or notebook. The thin notebook lower cover against lap is foreground and stays WHITE, not a gap. Fine gray allowed only at existing outer antialiased edges, full hair/pencil/cover/sole contour retained.

Everything unselected BLACK: naturally bright closed ivory curtains/linen/collar-like room highlights, cushion/pillows/knitthrow, lamp/shade/flowers/cup/table/books/left room/rug/floor and separate contact shadows. Not brightness thresholding. No color, checkerboard, gray backdrop, labels, outlines, new shadows or receiver patches. This mask only controls coverage; RGB later comes from untouched original mother ONCE under MAX(F,S).
